name: Withering raises Fel Fireball damage while Felforged is active (#3129)
contract: Withering 707416's flat aura (EffectBasePoints 29, die 1 => CalcValue 30) targets SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 (op12), which Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers routes to effect index 1 of whatever spell's CalcValue is being computed. Felforged's own effect index 1 (806104, EffectBasePoints -1, die 1 => CalcValue 0) is a SPELLMOD_DAMAGE percent SpellMod matching Fel Fireball's family20 flags; Withering's SpellMod matches Felforged's own SpellFamilyFlags (word1 bit22) and adds its flat 30 on top of Felforged's die-adjusted 0, making Felforged's own generated Fel Fireball damage modifier 30 (not the raw -1). So Felforged alone changes Fel Fireball damage by 0% (native CalcValue, not the tooltip's raw -1%), and Felforged plus Withering raises it by 30% (not 28%, which came from summing the raw, un-adjusted DBC base points -1+29). Fel Fireball rank 1 is spell 801312. Without Felforged up, Withering has no effect on Fel Fireball.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Withering has no effect on Fel Fireball while Felforged is not up
Felforged alone has no effect on Fel Fireball damage (its own EffectBasePoints -1, die 1, resolves to CalcValue 0)
Felforged plus Withering raises Fel Fireball damage by 30%
